context: Reference focused review: functional style should not be forced when a plain loop preserves early-exit and stateful-window behavior more clearly.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear accept/reject recommendation.

checklist.name: Rejects behavior-changing rewrite
checklist.description: Explains that the proposed filters include lines before the start marker and after the stop marker, so they do not preserve the original window and early-exit behavior.

checklist.name: Does not force functional style
checklist.description: States that the original loop or an equally clear branch-based implementation is appropriate for this stateful window and early break, rather than forcing a clever callback-heavy rewrite.

checklist.name: Provides safe direction
checklist.description: If suggesting cleanup, keeps the loop/branch structure or proposes a named helper that preserves start/stop semantics, blank filtering, trimming, and encounter order.

checklist.name: Keeps review focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated performance claims, dependencies, concurrency, broad API redesign, or internal workflow labels.
